documents.text: Pgvector stores embeddings and compares them using cosine similarity. HNSW is a graph index for approximate nearest neighbors.
A PostgreSQL row lock serializes concurrent document version assignments. A rollback restores transaction consistency.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked retrieval lists by summing the inverse of each result rank plus a damping constant.
Source provenance records the origin, page number, snapshot hash and revision of knowledge chunks. Audit logs preserve reviewer decisions.
Git assigns a content hash to a blob. A Git commit tracks a repository tree, its parent commits and author information.
The PostgreSQL pg_trgm extension stores trigram indexes and supports similarity of text values.
